borzoi_ensemble.corpus: UCSC hg38 and mm10 sequence paired with ENCODE, GTEx v8/recount3, FANTOM5, Roadmap and CATlas functional-genomics tracks

interpretation: The official weights predate held-back GSE289173 by approximately 18 months, the accession is absent from the exact released training-target manifest, and donor/cell-type eQTL and interaction-eQTL outcomes were not declared training targets. The checkpoint is target-label-unexposed for the held-back variant endpoint. This does not make genomic positions novel: the reference sequence was broadly used in pretraining, so held chromosome/LD blocks and receptive-field buffers remain mandatory.

noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.Genentech_gReLU_conversion: A separately converted four-member checkpoint may provide safer framework integration, but it is not the canonical upstream release. It cannot replace the official ensemble until every member passes native Calico numeric parity, track order, inverse-transform, reverse-complement and license-derivation checks.
noncanonical_checkpoint_findings.PyTorch_flashzoi_and_other_Hugging_Face_: Ports are independently versioned derivatives. Do not use their hashes, configs or declared licenses as evidence for the official TensorFlow HDF5 objects.
